author: Connor Creates
description:
your reminder to just be creative. Don’t worry about “sticking to one niche” or “staying in your lane”. Just do the thing. Whatever that may be. As long as it’s scratching your creative itch or you’re chasing your curiosity then go for it. Maybe you’ll fail, maybe you’re not actually good at it. But you’ll regret it if you don’t at least try. 

I’m grateful for the opportunity to do what I love and be creative in so many different ways. It’s truly the best! So thank you for being along for the ride!
title: your reminder to just be creative!
